sourcedDescription: dYdX Labs has confirmed that Arcus will launch its own token, separate from DYDX, with an allocation reserved for people who traded, staked, or validated on dYdX. Arcus Points are the main way to farm it now, although the team has not said how points will convert to tokens.
tagline_en: dYdX Labs has confirmed that Arcus will launch its own token, separate from DYDX, with an allocation reserved for people who traded, staked, or validated on dYdX. Arcus Points are the main way to farm it now, although the team has not said how points will convert to tokens.

sourcedSteps.title: Sign Up on Arcus
sourcedSteps.body: Go to Arcus and connect your wallet or sign up with Google. Signing up through our link gives you 5% off trading fees. Arcus is not available in the US, Canada, the UK, and other restricted jurisdictions.

sourcedSteps.title: Deposit Funds
sourcedSteps.body: Deposit USDC, USDT, BTC, or another supported asset into your Arcus account. You can buy these on Bybit , then move them to Robinhood Chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

sourcedSteps.title: Trade Stock Tokens on Spot
sourcedSteps.body: Open the spot market and trade any of the 95+ stock tokens. Spot trades carry no fees, and stock tokens currently earn boosted points. Trading outside regular US market hours adds a further boost. If you use Robinhood Wallet, swaps routed through Arcus also qualify for boosted spot points.

sourcedSteps.title: Unlock Perps With an Invite Code
sourcedSteps.body: Perps now require an invite code from an existing Arcus trader. Connect your wallet on Arcus and enter the code when prompted. Traders who already had access don’t need one.

sourcedSteps.title: Keep Collateral on the Exchange
sourcedSteps.body: Retained deposits count toward Season 1 points. Leaving collateral on Arcus between trades scores better than depositing and withdrawing each session.

sourcedSteps.title: Track Your Points
sourcedSteps.body: Open the Points Dashboard to see your weekly Season 1 points and your Season 0 leaderboard rank. New points land every Wednesday at 3PM EST.

sourcedSteps.title: Share Your Invite Codes
sourcedSteps.body: Every $1M in perps volume earns you an invite code, and volume from traders you referred counts toward that total. Find your codes under Rewards > Referrals. Anyone who signs up with your code becomes your referral, and their trading adds to your referral points bonus.
